history.content: ok so i dont even know why im opening this. just had my third doctors appointment in like two months and again they basically shrugged at me. another referral, another wait, another we'll see. im so tired of it
That sounds exhausting — like you’ve been handed one more wait after another. Is it mostly tiredness, or more of a frustrated kind of tired?

no its not tired tired. im ANGRY. like properly angry. ive been telling them for months somethings wrong with my stomach, cant eat properly, lost a bunch of weight, and they keep acting like im imagining it or its just stress. and today the guy literally didnt even look up from his screen

That sounds like anger with a sharp edge of being dismissed — especially after months of trying to get them to take your stomach seriously. Did it make you want to snap, or just feel hotter and more tense inside?

honestly both? i sat in the parking lot after and just gripped the wheel. didnt snap at him cos whats the point theyd just write me down as difficult. but heres the thing that gets me and i feel stupid even saying it... underneath the angry im kind of scared. like what if theres actually something really wrong and theyre missing it cos they cant be bothered to look properly
That sounds like anger with fear underneath it — gripping the wheel while also worrying they’re missing something serious. Want to stay with the fear a little, or leave it here for now?

i dont know. the fear is the part i cant control so i think thats why i keep landing back on angry, cos at least angry feels like im doing something? like the anger is easier to hold than just sitting there terrified that im not being heard. but yeah. both are real. its been a rough couple months and im just so done with not being believed

That makes sense — the anger feels like something you can hold, while the fear is just sitting there wanting to be believed. If you want, we can stay with what “not being believed” has come to mean for you, or leave it here.

yeah not being believed is the whole thing isnt it. its like everytime i go in i have to prove im sick enough to deserve them looking. and i shouldnt have to fight that hard. anyway i think ive got a new referral coming so i guess ill push on that one and actually write everything down this time so they cant brush me off. saying it out loud helps a bit weirdly
That sounds like the whole knot: having to prove you’re sick enough just to be looked at. We can leave it there, or stay with what “not being believed” has been costing you.
nah lets leave it there i think. i feel a bit less like im gonna explode which is something. thanks for letting me dump all that. gonna go write my list before i forget. cheers
Of course — it sounds like you got some shape around it, and I’m glad you could let it spill out here. Go write your list; we can pick this up again anytime.
